name: NightPay
description: NightPay's own colours: white words and round white buttons on its blue, in light and dark, a plain header and outlined cards. The welcome and log-in screens named, its logo as a picture where the owner shows what Relaid cannot read, its white pills filled where it draws them, and its unnamed MobilePay and Google log-in buttons named and filled there. Its MobilePay buttons said to use another app.
